intro: IBMR Gurgaon and MDI Gurgaon both sit in Gurgaon, and this page compares their recorded MBA / PGDM fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.
IBMR Gurgaon vs MDI Gurgaon is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. MDI Gurgaon holds a NIRF 2025 rank of 9; IBMR Gurgaon has no NIRF rank on this page.

sections.heading: IBMR Gurgaon vs MDI Gurgaon for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IBMR Gurgaon if its MBA / PGDM programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want.
Choose MDI Gurgaon if its course mix, city or recorded fee level is the better fit, rather than looking for one campus that wins on every count.

IBMR Gurgaon lists MBA + PGPM, PGPM + PGDM. MDI Gurgaon lists Executive PGDM Business Management, Executive PGDM Public Policy and Management, Post Graduate Diploma in Business Analytics (PGDBA) and more.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.
Our records list ₹2.42 lakh a year as tuition fees for IBMR Gurgaon's MBA + PGPM. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
For MDI Gurgaon our records now show a reconstructed two-year PGDM total of ₹26.55 lakh, from the two annual Total Fees rows of ₹13,48,905 and ₹13,06,405.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, IBMR Gurgaon's 2020 figures are an average of ₹6 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh for MBA + PGPM. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.

In our records, MDI Gurgaon's 2024 figures are an average of ₹26 lakh and a highest of ₹63 lakh for Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM General Management. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
The recorded years are 2020 and 2024, so the two packages should not be read as a head-to-head for the same graduating class.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for IBMR Gurgaon on this MBA / PGDM page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
MDI Gurgaon's recorded admission tests on this page include CAT.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Gurgaon, Delhi NCR. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, MDI Gurgaon is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
IBMR Gurgaon can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
